source: ZXNAME0000XZ capacity and ZXNAME0001XZ bandwidth are independent specifications. More capacity lets a larger model or working set remain on the device. More bandwidth lets the memory system sustain a higher rate of transfers. Increasing one does not mathematically imply the other.
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ容量和ZXNAME0001XZ带宽是独立的规格。更大的容量可以让更大的模型或工作集保留在设备上。更大的带宽可以让内存系统维持更高的传输速率。增加一个在数学上并不意味着另一个。
